text: First look: a little floating island at night, a garden bed with red crops, a blue bunny-ish creature. Day 2, 22/30 sec. Coins 10, Lv1 0/95. A hint says 'Tap the ripe crop'. I'll tap the crop bed.
Momo is now 'Working at Farm', 1/4 tiles assigned. The other tiles are bare grass, so nothing else to assign. Days fly by - 30 seconds each. Pressing the checkmark to confirm.
Momo now works the farm by itself: 6 jobs, coins 19, +9/min. A mail icon pops over Momo and the Mailbox has a red dot. Checking the mailbox.

Research tree with tabs Farm, Lumber, Mine, Smelting, Power, Games... Field expansion needs 3 flasks + 20 coins, and it says Build a research lab. Flasks probably come from the lab. Tapping that button.
Build menu popped up: Farm 10 coins, Mine opens Lv3, Lumberyard & Research lab open at Lv2, Special 0/1. I'm Lv1 50/95. I have 40 coins so I'll build a second farm.
It built the farm on the right-hand tile by itself (I didn't pick the spot), 2 seconds construction. Another letter waiting. Opening mail.
Level 2 reached! That should unlock the research lab and lumberyard. Closing mail and tapping an empty grass tile to see if the build menu appears there.
Research lab is going up on the left tile (cost 40). New hint: 'Tap the glowing sea to grow the island' with a yellow box at lower right. I'll tap inside the box.

Bought land for 30, island grew - now 2 farms, a lab and an empty tile. The tree moved/vanished? Momo walked to the lab. Long tip about building/demolishing. Tapping Got it. Coins 14, so I'll wait a bit before building.
Third letter: Bigger harvests. Accepted. Flask counter now shows 2 under the day - the lab is producing research flasks. Field expansion needs 3. Going to Research to see if I can start it.
Hiring a second Momo costs 90 - too much for now (47). Flasks hit 3 and Research has a red dot, so I'll start Field expansion.
Research started, 20 seconds. Momo is busy at the lab while both farms sit ripe. I'll close the panel and harvest by hand to help.
Field expansion done (+1 crop per harvest) and Level 3. Another tip: sea next to the island can be bought for 40. Coins 60. Level 3 should open the Mine. Dismissing the tip.
Build menu opened from the empty tile. Mine needs 120 + 10 wood, so a Lumberyard (80) has to come first. I'll add a cheap 3rd farm for 10 and then save for a second Momo (90).

Status shows the goal clearly! To become a City: Land 5/9, Momo 1/3, Research levels 1/3, Value produced 186/1.5K. Now I have a plan: hire Momos, more research, buy land. Coins 86, hire costs 90 - almost.
Hired a second Momo named Mochi - cute! It's heading to the new farm, with numbered tiles 1 and 2 shown. I'll let the game's default assignment stand and dismiss the tip.
Started Watering efficiency (1.5 min). Income is up to 120/min with two Momos. Next I want to buy sea land for 40 to work toward Land 9.
Bought land (now a grassy plot with a bush, bottom-left). Another dashed plot appeared next to it. Coins 84. Checking its price.
Second land plot bought for 55. Island is getting long and now runs off the bottom of the screen. Checking the price of a third Momo.
Third Momo costs 145 (price went up from 90). I have 101. While I save, I'll drop a 10-coin farm onto the new land.
Hired Pomu, Momo #3. The top-left now says Next: City 1/4, so that requirement is done. Next is research: I'll queue another level as soon as Watering efficiency finishes.
Field expansion Lv2 underway (30s). Now for land: the island runs off the bottom of the screen, so I'll try dragging the view up to reach the next sea plot.
Bought two more plots (70, 90) - City 3/4 now! Land 9 and research must both be met. Checking Status for how far Value produced still has to go.

Land 9/9, Momo 3/3, Research 3/3 all checked. Only Value produced left: 801 of 1.5K at about 267/min, so ~2.6 min and I have ~2:15. I'll add cheap farms on the empty tiles and harvest by hand to speed it up.
Two new farms placed. The lower-left one is already ripe and no Momo is on it, so I'll harvest it by hand. Coins 273.
Hired a 4th Momo (235). My taps on farms keep selecting whichever Momo is standing there instead of harvesting - a bit fiddly. Four Momos cover every farm now. Checking Value produced.
Value produced 1.2K/1.5K at 336/min - so close to City. I'll leave Status open and watch.
It reads 1.5K/1.5K but Become a City is still greyed and there's no check mark - must be rounding. Tapping it anyway in a few seconds.
